data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,149.823m. Using the available claims development table (net basis) the prior-year re-estimation for underwriting years up to 2016 indicates a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 55.9m (4.9% of opening gross reserves). The report cites adverse large loss experience in the International Casualty portfolio (notably Australia and New Zealand) and other development and reinsurance effects as drivers. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the accounts; the computation above is derived from the net claims development table and is therefore flagged as a fallback/net-based estimate.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement was reported. A GROSS 'movement in prior years' note was not available. The prior-year development figure above was derived using the available NET claims development triangle (note 15) as a fallback; therefore the movement is a NET-based calculation converted to millions and may not represent the true GROSS prior-year reserve movement. Reinsurance to Close activity and reinsurance recoverables (large movement in reinsurers' share) may distort the triangle. Use with caution.
